artboards.title: 08 · Screen states (empty, loading, error, forbidden, package off)

annotations.text:
Care Net AI tasks module · Sales first

MyClinicOnline tasks land in Supabase, Grok agents read them, create one parent task per client, draft subtasks along the client journey and propose who does the work. AI drafts, a named human signs. Managers oversee through role rights.

Journey stages used everywhere: Prospect · Quote · Onboard · Schedule · Clinic day · Certificates · Invoice · Renewal.

Matched to the CNC Sales platform handoff
Shell: Client Portal AppShell (216px white sidebar, 64px top bar, StatCard 104px, attribution footer). Tokens: design/tokens (red #ED1B24, charcoal #1E1E1E, greys #787878 / #F0F0F0 / #E2E2E2, blue links, green success, yellow warning). Type: Montserrat 600 headings, Open Sans body. Radii 6 / 10 / 14.
Rules applied: British English, sentence case, no dash punctuation, AutoHive CRM only, [CONFIRM] on unconfirmed values, mock data labelled, no contact email or phone on boards, cases by number not worker name, medical outcomes never in the sales app.

Open questions for the build
· 20 medical threshold for Sales Manager sign off [CONFIRM].
· MCO task type to journey stage mapping (draft on screen 06).
· Sync interval, default 15 minutes [CONFIRM].
· May Grok close portal tasks when MCO marks them Completed, or always ask?
· Attribution pill on CNC screens [CONFIRM per licence tier].
· Team lead layer: needed now or when the team grows?
